name: InterGenOS Launch Monitor
description: Moves a launched game window to the monitor you declare, before its first frame. Under GNOME Wayland only the compositor may place another client's window, so this in-compositor mover watches window-created for game window classes (Steam's universal steam_app_* class + gamescope by default; user-extensible) and moves a match to the declared output via Mutter's move_to_monitor(). You declare the launch monitor in the extension preferences; the system obeys. Inert until a monitor is declared (empty = no-op), and fail-safe: an unresolved/absent declared output never moves the window.
